## Part UK — Code pages (tasks UK1–UK5)


**Goal of this part:** give the five code items of the catalog their **pages**. One page creator, `window.ECalcCodePage.create(options)` (new `ecalc-code-page.js`), serves all of them; the `code` kind of the item picks a controller and the tables come from `item.data`. **Resistor** and **inductor** pages draw the part as an SVG (`ecalc-code-draw.js`, DOM-free string builders) with 3, 4, 5 or 6 colour bands (inductor: 4 EIA, 5 MIL) that are buttons: a click, Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens a menu of the colours that fit the role of the band, each with a swatch in the `hex` of the data. A value field shows the bands of the nearest standard value, tolerance and temperature coefficient are selects, and the warnings of the engine are listed. **SMD resistor** prints the code on a chip (3-digit, 4-digit, EIA-96 and R notation; every marking of an encode result is a button that prints it), **capacitor** reads and writes value code, tolerance letter and voltage code on a disc, **ceramic temperature** decodes and encodes class 1 and class 2 with quick-pick buttons for the common codes. All decoding and encoding goes through `ECalcCore.codes` (Part K); errors of the engine are shown inline and tint the field they came from, nothing is thrown. What the user entered persists per item in the ECalc store. 45 strings in 16 languages, a `/* code pages */` section at the end of the stylesheet and the browser tests of all five pages (decode and encode paths, band clicks and keyboard, errors, persistence, a contrast check in all 15 desktop skins, a phone-sized window).

**Prerequisites (Parts A, UT and K of the same wave, applied first and uncommitted or committed):** `ECalcCore.codes = {decode, encode}` (`ecalc-codes.js`, Part K) and the five code items in the catalog JSON; the page-creator contract of Part UT (the shell calls `window.ECalcCodePage.create(options)` and shows `desktop.ecalc_page_unavailable` while it is missing; `ecalc-table-page.js` and `ecalc-tables.js` are already in the loader entry); `window.ECalcCalcPage.copyText` (Part UT); the fixture `newECalcBrowserFixture` of `ui/desktop_ecalc_fixture_test.go` (Part UT); `ecalcScripts` that no longer pins "exactly 21 scripts" (Part UT, deviation 7 there).

**Order:** UK1 → UK2 → UK3 → UK4 → UK5. UK4 writes the three browser tests first; they are skipped unless `AURAGO_RUN_BROWSER_SMOKE=1` and stay red with it until UK5 puts the page in place, so every commit keeps `go test ./ui` green.

### How this part was made and verified

The part was built for real in a scratch worktree (base `4b3b14ec0` plus Parts A, UT and K, all uncommitted) and verified there: the five pages were opened and driven in the real desktop shell in German (the served catalog with the real code items), every code block below was **generated** from the verified files by a script, and the plan was then **replayed task by task** on the files with this part removed (a script that reads this very file applies every "Create", "Append to", "Replace in" and "Run script" block; the red and green runs of every task are recorded in Verification and the files equal the verified ones byte for byte afterwards, line endings aside).

### Contract deviations

Where this list and the contract disagree, this list wins.

1. **The band selector offers every layout of the data.** Resistor: **3, 4, 5, 6** bands (the contract says 4/5/6; the 3-band code without a tolerance band, ±20 %, is in the data and Part K reads and writes it, so the selector shows it; 4 is the default). Inductor: **4 (EIA)** and **5 (MIL)**.
2. **The page object is `{el, layout, refresh, dispose}`** (the optional `focusFilter` of Part UT's contract is the table page's; code pages have no filter box). `layout()` only repositions an open colour menu.
3. **What the engine returns in English stays English:** the warnings, the notation texts of the fields (`3-digit code`, `EIA-96`, `RKM notation`, the inductor layout) and the message of an error. The page translates the **names** of the fields by their id (20 keys `desktop.ecalc_code_field_<id>`, listed one by one in the page: no dynamic key) and puts a translated lead in front of an error (3 keys: `…_error_invalid_code`, `…_invalid_value`, `…_unsupported`), for example "Der Aufdruck ist nicht lesbar: cannot read "ABC" as an SMD resistor code …".
4. **Colours.** Only the colour bands (and the swatches of the menu and of the reading) take colour from the data: the `hex` is the `fill` attribute of the band, no stylesheet rule sets it. Everything else is tokens: body, leads and outlines take `--vd-text`, the captions the muted text colour, the **SMD chip takes the text colour as its body and the strong panel colour as its print** (legible by construction; measured print on chip ≥ 10 and chip on stage ≥ 10 in all 15 skins), not a literal black chip with white print. **Addition:** the capacitor and the ceramic page draw a disc with the printed code (the spec only asks for the SMD chip).
5. **Menus.** A resistor menu lists the colours that have the field of the band's role (a digit band: `digit`, multiplier: `exp`, tolerance: `tol` without `none`, tcr: `tcr`), as Part K's data notes say. The military inductor bands 2 to 4 list every colour that can stand there (the digits, and gold as the decimal point in bands 2 and 3); a combination the engine rejects is not excluded from the menu but reported inline (`band 4 (grey) cannot be a multiplier (black, brown, red or orange)`), so that no state is unreachable. **The Space key opens the menu when it is released**, so that the release does not land on the first option and pick it.
6. **Edits outside the files this part owns**, all needed to test or to run it: `ui/desktop_ecalc_test.go` (+3 lines in `TestECalcUsesOnlyItsOwnTranslationKeys`: the keys of `ecalcCodeKeys` are allowed; the contract's list of keys is a ceiling that every part extends), `ui/js/desktop/core/module-loader.js` (the contract has the controller add the three scripts: UK5 gives the exact two "Replace in" blocks), `ui/lang/desktop/*.json` (UK1 inserts the strings by script; the same strings are delivered as `uk-keys.json`).
7. **One test file** (`ui/desktop_ecalc_codes_browser_test.go`) holds the source tests and the browser tests, as the contract names one file; the tests that need the page are added in UK4 and UK5, the ones about strings, drawings and stylesheet in UK1 to UK3.
8. **Persisted shape.** The store is used as the calculators use it, `store.saveCalc(item.id, {inputs, choices})`: for a code item `inputs` hold the texts of the fields (`colors`, `value`, `tolerance`, `tempco` / `code`, `value`, `tolerance`, `voltage` / `code`, `tempco`, `low`, `high`, `change`, `tol`) and `choices` the selectors (`bands`, `class`). A state that does not fit the item any more (an unknown colour, a wrong number of bands) is not used, the page opens with its example. The five items count towards the 200 entries the store keeps.
9. **Strings: 45 keys** (`desktop.ecalc_code_*`: 15 for the page, 7 band roles, 3 error leads, 20 field names), in `ecalcCodeKeys` of the test file; the page names every one as a literal.

### What the other parts get from this part

- **Part Z (controller).** Merge points are listed in "Notes for the controller". The loader entry needs `ecalc-codes.js` (Part K) after `ecalc-tables.js` and `ecalc-code-draw.js`, `ecalc-code-page.js` after `ecalc-table-page.js`; UK5 does both. The stylesheet section sits at the very end of `ui/css/desktop-app-ecalc.css`, delimited by `/* code pages */` and `/* end of code pages */` (`TestECalcCodeStylesheetSection` pins both and that nothing follows).
- **Part B (tool).** Nothing: the page reads the catalog JSON and `ECalcCore.codes` only.
- **Part K.** The pages rely on `item.data` exactly as K's "What the other parts get" lists it (colours with `hex` and localized `name`, `layouts`, `mil_role`, `eia_*`/`mil_*`, `tolerances`, `voltages`, `class1`/`class2`, `common`, `notes`), on the result shape `{kind, code, bands, value, dim, fields, warnings}` and on `Error.code` ∈ `invalid_code`, `invalid_value`, `unsupported`.

### Environment

- Windows box. Go: set `GOTMPDIR` to a short backslash path (`$env:GOTMPDIR = 'C:\tmp\go-build-ecalc-p3-uk'`, create the folder once). If D: (the Go cache) is full use a per-run `GOCACHE`.
- Browser tests need `AURAGO_RUN_BROWSER_SMOKE=1` and Chrome started from a test binary: run them from PowerShell with the sandbox disabled. `AURAGO_BROWSER_ARTIFACT_DIR` keeps screenshots (`code-resistor`, `code-resistor-menu`, `code-resistor-six-bands`, `code-resistor-error`, `code-inductor-error`, `code-smd`, `code-smd-error`, `code-capacitor`, `code-ceramic`, the skin shots `code-resistor-<skin>` and `code-smd-<skin>`, and the phone-sized `code-compact-menu`, `code-compact-capacitor`).
- The working copies of `ui/js/**` and `ui/css/**` may be CRLF on a Windows checkout (git stores LF): use an edit tool that matches across line endings or normalise the file to LF first. Every "Replace in" block must match exactly once; the stylesheet section is appended with the line endings of the file.
- Tools that decode backslash-u escapes (the Write/Edit tools): none of the code below contains one; write µ, Ω, °, ², ×, ±, · and the minus sign as characters.
- GitNexus: before modifying an existing function run `node .gitnexus/run.cjs impact "<symbol>" --direction upstream --repo .`; before every commit run `detect_changes` (the index is behind the working tree: re-run `analyze` first, or read `partial`/`behind` as "unseen", not "clean"). This part changes no function of the code base; the one existing function it edits is the Go test `TestECalcUsesOnlyItsOwnTranslationKeys` (three lines in UK5): impact on 2026-11-02 `risk: UNKNOWN`, no callers resolved (confirmed by grep: only `go test` runs it, nothing calls it), so the edit is a plain allow-list extension. `ecalcScripts` is only read.
- Commit messages end with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Bundles: nothing in this part changes a bundled file (`module-loader.js` is loaded by `desktop.html`, not part of `main.bundle.js`); `node scripts/build-ui-bundles.js --check` stays clean (run in UK5).

### Task UK1: Strings of the code pages (16 languages)

**Files:**
- Create: `ui/desktop_ecalc_codes_browser_test.go` (first part: `ecalcCodeKeys`, `ecalcCodePlaceholders`, `TestECalcCodeLocaleKeys`)
- Modify: `ui/lang/desktop/{cs,da,de,el,en,es,fr,hi,it,ja,nl,no,pl,pt,sv,zh}.json` (45 keys each, inserted into the sorted `desktop.ecalc_*` run, between `ecalc_chart` and `ecalc_combo_deviation`)

The keys are named in contract deviation 9. The locale test requires every key in every language and keeps the placeholders `{n}`, `{role}`, `{color}` of the two strings that have them.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

Create `ui/desktop_ecalc_codes_browser_test.go`:

```go
package ui

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// The code pages of ECalc (phase 3, part UK): resistor and inductor colour bands, SMD resistor, capacitor and ceramic
// temperature codes. The tests at the top and at the end are source tests (they always run): the 45 translation keys in 16
// languages, the DOM-free drawing builders, the stylesheet section, the loader order, the use of the codes engine and of the
// store. The tests in the middle drive the pages inside the real desktop shell (AURAGO_RUN_BROWSER_SMOKE=1).

// ecalcCodeKeys are the strings of the code pages (desktop.ecalc_code_*); the page names every one of them as a literal.
var ecalcCodeKeys = []string{
	"desktop.ecalc_code_auto", "desktop.ecalc_code_band_aria", "desktop.ecalc_code_bands", "desktop.ecalc_code_class_1", "desktop.ecalc_code_class_2",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_colors", "desktop.ecalc_code_common", "desktop.ecalc_code_empty", "desktop.ecalc_code_error_invalid_code",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_error_invalid_value", "desktop.ecalc_code_error_unsupported", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_change",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_field_change_minus", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_change_plus", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_class", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_code_3digit",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_field_code_4digit", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_code_eia96", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_family", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_industry_code",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_field_layout", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_rkm", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_tc", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_tcr",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_field_temp_high", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_temp_low", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_tolerance", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_tolerance_minus",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_field_tolerance_plus", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_value_code", "desktop.ecalc_code_field_voltage", "desktop.ecalc_code_hint",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_marking", "desktop.ecalc_code_menu", "desktop.ecalc_code_none", "desktop.ecalc_code_notes", "desktop.ecalc_code_print",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_result", "desktop.ecalc_code_role_digit", "desktop.ecalc_code_role_identifier", "desktop.ecalc_code_role_multiplier",
	"desktop.ecalc_code_role_point", "desktop.ecalc_code_role_tcr", "desktop.ecalc_code_role_tolerance", "desktop.ecalc_code_role_value",
}

var ecalcCodePlaceholders = map[string][]string{
	"desktop.ecalc_code_band_aria": {"{n}", "{role}", "{color}"},
	"desktop.ecalc_code_menu":      {"{n}"},
}

func TestECalcCodeLocaleKeys(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	if len(ecalcCodeKeys) != 45 {
		t.Errorf("%d code keys are listed, want the 45 of the plan", len(ecalcCodeKeys))
	}
	for _, lang := range []string{"cs", "da", "de", "el", "en", "es", "fr", "hi", "it", "ja", "nl", "no", "pl", "pt", "sv", "zh"} {
		words := readMergedLangMap(t, lang)
		for _, key := range ecalcCodeKeys {
			if strings.TrimSpace(words[key]) == "" {
				t.Errorf("%s misses %s", lang, key)
			}
		}
		for key, placeholders := range ecalcCodePlaceholders {
			for _, placeholder := range placeholders {
				if !strings.Contains(words[key], placeholder) {
					t.Errorf("%s: %s must keep the %s placeholder: %q", lang, key, placeholder, words[key])
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

```js
// The strings of the 16 languages as {language: {key: text}}; the placeholders of the English text are kept everywhere.
const strings = {};
for (const lang of Object.keys(T).sort()) {
    if (T[lang].length !== ORDER.length) throw new Error(lang + ' has ' + T[lang].length + ' strings, want ' + ORDER.length);
    strings[lang] = {};
    ORDER.forEach((name, index) => { strings[lang]['desktop.ecalc_code_' + name] = T[lang][index]; });
}
for (const lang of Object.keys(strings)) {
    for (const [key, text] of Object.entries(strings[lang])) {
        const want = (strings.en[key].match(/\{[a-z]+\}/g) || []).sort().join(',');
        const got = (text.match(/\{[a-z]+\}/g) || []).sort().join(',');
        if (want !== got || !text.trim()) throw new Error(lang + ' ' + key + ': placeholders ' + got + ' (want ' + want + ') or empty text');
    }
}

// Inserts the keys into the sorted desktop.ecalc_* run of ui/lang/desktop/<lang>.json (one line each, the style of the file).
const dir = process.argv[2] || 'ui/lang/desktop';
for (const lang of Object.keys(strings)) {
    const file = dir + '/' + lang + '.json';
    const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    if (text.includes('"desktop.ecalc_code_bands"')) { console.log(lang + ': already there'); continue; }
    const eol = text.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n';
    const lines = text.split(eol);
    const isEcalc = line => /^\s*"desktop\.ecalc_[a-z0-9_]+":/.test(line);
    const keyOf = line => /^\s*"(desktop\.ecalc_[a-z0-9_]+)":/.exec(line)[1];
    const first = lines.findIndex(isEcalc);
    let last = first;
    while (last + 1 < lines.length && isEcalc(lines[last + 1])) last += 1;
    if (first < 0 || !lines[last].trimEnd().endsWith(',')) throw new Error(lang + ': no sorted ecalc run in the middle of the file');
    const run = lines.slice(first, last + 1);
    const added = Object.keys(strings[lang]).map(key => '  ' + JSON.stringify(key) + ': ' + JSON.stringify(strings[lang][key]) + ',');
    const merged = run.concat(added).sort((x, y) => (keyOf(x) < keyOf(y) ? -1 : keyOf(x) > keyOf(y) ? 1 : 0));
    lines.splice(first, run.length, ...merged);
    fs.writeFileSync(file, lines.join(eol));
    JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
    console.log(lang + ': inserted ' + added.length + ' keys');
}
```

`ECalcCodeDraw.bandsSVG(spec)` draws an axial resistor or inductor with 3 to 6 (resistor) or 4 and 5 (inductor) colour bands, each band a focusable button (`<g class="ec-band" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded>`) with a wide invisible hit area, the band rectangle (its `fill` is the hex of the data, checked by `safeColor`: a hex colour or `transparent`, anything else draws an empty dashed band), a focus ring and a caption under it. `chipSVG(spec)` draws the SMD chip or the disc with up to two lines of printed text. Both builders are DOM-free strings, escape everything and know no colour: body, leads and outlines are `currentColor`/classes of the stylesheet (UK3).

```go
		`aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded=`, "tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\"", "resistor: { 3:", "inductor: { 4:", "const colour = safeColor(band.color)",
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the builders**

Create `ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-code-draw.js`:

```js
/* ECalc code drawings: the parts that the code pages show. A DOM-free classic script that publishes window.ECalcCodeDraw and
   builds inline SVG strings, like the chart and the schematics do. The colour of a band is the `hex` of the code item's data
   and nothing else (a black band stays black in every desktop skin); the body, the leads, the outlines and the captions take
   currentColor and the classes ec-draw-*, ec-band-* and ec-chip-* of css/desktop-app-ecalc.css (tokens only).

   ECalcCodeDraw.bandsSVG(spec) -> SVG markup of an axial part with colour bands.
     spec: {kind: 'resistor' | 'inductor', label, interactive, open, bands: [{color, name, role, roleLabel, caption, aria, wide}]}
           kind         the body shape and the band positions (resistor: 3 to 6 bands, inductor: 4 or 5)
           label        accessible name of the drawing
           interactive  the bands are buttons (tabindex 0, aria-haspopup="listbox") that open the colour menu of the page
           open         index of the band whose menu is open (aria-expanded), or -1
           bands[]      color   the hex of the colour ('transparent' draws a dashed empty band)
                        name    the colour name in the language of the catalog (part of the accessible name)
                        role    digit, multiplier, tolerance, tcr, identifier, value (data-role, for the page and the tests)
                        caption the short text under the band (the digit, the multiplier, the tolerance ...)
                        aria    the accessible name of the band
                        wide    the band is drawn wider (the tolerance band and the military identifier)
   ECalcCodeDraw.chipSVG(spec) -> SVG markup of an SMD chip or a disc capacitor with its printed code.
     spec: {shape: 'chip' | 'disc', lines: [text], label, valid}   (disc: up to two lines, chip: the first line)
   ECalcCodeDraw.safeColor(text) -> the text when it is a hex colour or 'transparent', else ''. Both builders escape everything. */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const escape = text => String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, char => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[char]));
    const HEX = /^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{4}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/;
    const safeColor = text => (typeof text === 'string' && (HEX.test(text) || text === 'transparent') ? text : '');

    const WIDTH = 400, HEIGHT = 130, MIDDLE = 60;
    const BAND_WIDTH = 14, WIDE_WIDTH = 20;
    // The straight part of the body is x 112 .. 288; every band lies inside it. Each entry is the left edge of a band.
    const POSITIONS = {
        resistor: { 3: [132, 160, 188], 4: [128, 156, 184, 246], 5: [124, 148, 172, 196, 248], 6: [122, 144, 166, 188, 232, 262] },
        inductor: { 4: [136, 164, 192, 250], 5: [124, 158, 182, 206, 252] }
    };
    const BODY = {
        resistor: { x: 88, y: 30, width: 224, height: 60, rx: 26 },
        inductor: { x: 88, y: 22, width: 224, height: 76, rx: 14 }
    };

    function bandMarkup(band, index, box, left, interactive, open) {
        const wide = !!band.wide, width = wide ? WIDE_WIDTH : BAND_WIDTH;
        const colour = safeColor(band.color), empty = colour === '' || colour === 'transparent';
        const y = box.y + 1, height = box.height - 2;
        const attributes = ' data-index="' + index + '" data-role="' + escape(band.role || '') + '" data-color="' + escape(band.name || '') + '"'
            + (interactive ? ' tabindex="0" role="button" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="' + (open === index ? 'true' : 'false') + '" aria-label="' + escape(band.aria || band.name || '') + '"' : '');
        return '<g class="ec-band"' + attributes + '>'
            + '<rect class="ec-band-hit" x="' + (left - 5) + '" y="' + (box.y - 8) + '" width="' + (width + 10) + '" height="' + (box.height + 16) + '"/>'
            + '<rect class="ec-band-fill' + (empty ? ' ec-band-empty' : '') + '" x="' + left + '" y="' + y + '" width="' + width + '" height="' + height + '"' + (empty ? ' fill="none"' : ' fill="' + colour + '"') + '/>'
            + '<rect class="ec-band-ring" x="' + (left - 3) + '" y="' + (y - 3) + '" width="' + (width + 6) + '" height="' + (height + 6) + '" rx="3"/>'
            + (band.caption ? '<text class="ec-draw-cap" x="' + (left + width / 2) + '" y="' + (box.y + box.height + 26) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + escape(band.caption) + '</text>' : '')
            + '</g>';
    }

    function bandsSVG(spec) {
        const kind = spec && spec.kind === 'inductor' ? 'inductor' : 'resistor';
        const bands = spec && Array.isArray(spec.bands) ? spec.bands : [];
        const positions = POSITIONS[kind][bands.length];
        if (!positions) return '';
        const box = BODY[kind], interactive = !!spec.interactive, open = Number.isInteger(spec.open) ? spec.open : -1;
        return '<svg class="ec-code-art" data-art="' + kind + '" data-bands="' + bands.length + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + WIDTH + ' ' + HEIGHT + '" role="group" aria-label="' + escape(spec.label || '') + '" focusable="false">'
            + '<line class="ec-draw-lead" x1="12" y1="' + MIDDLE + '" x2="' + box.x + '" y2="' + MIDDLE + '"/><line class="ec-draw-lead" x1="' + (box.x + box.width) + '" y1="' + MIDDLE + '" x2="388" y2="' + MIDDLE + '"/>'
            + '<rect class="ec-draw-body" x="' + box.x + '" y="' + box.y + '" width="' + box.width + '" height="' + box.height + '" rx="' + box.rx + '"/>'
            + bands.map((band, index) => bandMarkup(band, index, box, positions[index], interactive, open)).join('')
            + '</svg>';
    }

    // The printed text of a chip or a disc: the size follows the longest line so that it always fits the body.
    function inkSize(lines, room, limit) {
        const longest = Math.max(2, ...lines.map(line => line.length));
        return Math.max(12, Math.min(limit, Math.floor(room / (0.62 * longest))));
    }

    function chipSVG(spec) {
        const disc = !!spec && spec.shape === 'disc';
        const lines = (spec && Array.isArray(spec.lines) ? spec.lines : []).map(line => String(line == null ? '' : line)).filter(line => line !== '').slice(0, disc ? 2 : 1);
        const valid = !spec || spec.valid !== false;
        let body, ink = '';
        if (disc) {
            body = '<line class="ec-draw-lead" x1="92" y1="104" x2="92" y2="126"/><line class="ec-draw-lead" x1="148" y1="104" x2="148" y2="126"/>'
                + '<circle class="ec-disc-body" cx="120" cy="58" r="48"/>';
            const size = inkSize(lines, 78, 30);
            ink = lines.map((line, index) => '<text class="ec-disc-text" x="120" y="' + (lines.length === 1 ? 58 + size * 0.36 : 50 + index * (size + 4) + size * 0.3) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' + size + '">' + escape(line) + '</text>').join('');
        } else {
            body = '<rect class="ec-chip-end" x="30" y="24" width="26" height="72" rx="3"/><rect class="ec-chip-end" x="184" y="24" width="26" height="72" rx="3"/>'
                + '<rect class="ec-chip-body" x="48" y="20" width="144" height="80" rx="4"/>';
            const size = inkSize(lines, 118, 40);
            ink = lines.map(line => '<text class="ec-chip-text" x="120" y="' + (60 + size * 0.36) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' + size + '">' + escape(line) + '</text>').join('');
        }
        return '<svg class="ec-code-art" data-art="' + (disc ? 'disc' : 'chip') + '" data-valid="' + (valid ? 'true' : 'false') + '" viewBox="0 0 240 130" role="img" aria-label="' + escape(spec && spec.label) + '" focusable="false">' + body + ink + '</svg>';
    }

    window.ECalcCodeDraw = { bandsSVG, chipSVG, safeColor, POSITIONS };
})();
```

```css
/* code pages */
/* The five code items (resistor and inductor colour bands, SMD resistor, capacitor, ceramic temperature). The
   colour of a band comes from the data of the item (an SVG attribute of the drawing, never from here); the body, the leads,
   the outlines, the captions and the printed text of a chip take tokens, so the drawing is legible in every desktop skin. */
.ec-code-page { max-width: 980px; }
.ec-code-main { display: grid; gap: 14px; min-width: 0; }
.ec-code-stage { position: relative; justify-items: center; }
.ec-code-art-host { width: 100%; max-width: 480px; }
.ec-code-art { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; color: var(--vd-text); overflow: visible; }
.ec-code-art[data-art="chip"], .ec-code-art[data-art="disc"] { max-width: 300px; margin: 0 auto; }
.ec-draw-body { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 12%, transparent); stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1.6; }
.ec-draw-lead { stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .7; }
.ec-draw-cap { fill: var(--vd-theme-muted); font: 11px/1 var(--ec-mono); }
.ec-band { cursor: pointer; outline: none; }
.ec-band-hit { fill: transparent; }
.ec-band-fill { stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-opacity: .8; stroke-width: 1; }
.ec-band-empty { stroke-dasharray: 3 2; }
.ec-band-ring { fill: none; stroke: transparent; stroke-width: 2.5; }
.ec-band:hover .ec-band-ring { stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-color-border-focus) 55%, transparent); }
.ec-band:focus-visible .ec-band-ring, .ec-band[aria-expanded="true"] .ec-band-ring { stroke: var(--ds-color-border-focus); }
.ec-chip-body { fill: var(--vd-text); }
.ec-chip-end { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 40%, transparent); stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1.2; }
.ec-chip-text { fill: var(--vd-theme-panel-bg-strong, var(--vd-theme-panel-bg)); font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.ec-disc-body { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 12%, transparent); stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1.6; }
.ec-disc-text { fill: var(--vd-text); font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.ec-code-art[data-valid="false"] :is(.ec-chip-text, .ec-disc-text) { opacity: .45; }
.ec-code-hint { margin: 0; color: var(--vd-theme-muted); font-size: 12.5px; text-align: center; }

/* The colour menu under a band */
.ec-code-menu { position: absolute; z-index: 20; left: var(--ec-menu-x, 0); top: var(--ec-menu-y, 100%); display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 220px; max-width: min(360px, 100%); max-height: min(400px, 70vh); padding: 4px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--vd-mat-card-border, var(--vd-theme-border)); border-radius: var(--vd-mat-card-radius, var(--ds-radius-md)); background: var(--vd-theme-panel-bg-strong, var(--vd-theme-panel-bg)); box-shadow: var(--vd-mat-card-shadow, 0 12px 32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 22%, transparent)); }
.ec-code-opt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-height: 32px; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--ds-radius-sm); background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.ec-code-opt:hover { background: var(--vd-mat-hover, var(--vd-theme-control-hover)); }
.ec-app .ec-code-opt:focus-visible { outline-offset: -2px; }
.ec-code-opt[aria-selected="true"] { border-color: var(--vd-mat-selected-color, var(--vd-theme-accent-border)); background: var(--vd-mat-selected, var(--vd-theme-accent-soft)); box-shadow: var(--vd-mat-selected-edge, none); color: var(--vd-mat-selected-text, inherit); }
.ec-opt-name { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-weight: 600; }
.ec-opt-meaning { color: var(--vd-theme-muted); font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-size: 12.5px; white-space: nowrap; }
.ec-code-opt[aria-selected="true"] .ec-opt-meaning { color: inherit; opacity: .85; }
.ec-swatch { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.ec-swatch rect { stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-opacity: .7; stroke-width: 1; }

/* The fields: the chips of the calculator pages with a select where the data lists the choices */
.ec-code-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; align-items: start; }
.ec-code-fields > .ec-choice { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.ec-code-class { display: contents; }
.ec-select-wrap { position: relative; display: block; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
.ec-select-wrap::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 9px; top: 50%; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-right: 1.5px solid var(--vd-theme-muted); border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--vd-theme-muted); transform: translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg); pointer-events: none; }
.ec-code-select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 26px; padding: 0 22px 0 5px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--ds-radius-xs, 4px); background: transparent; color: var(--vd-text); font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-size: 13px; text-overflow: ellipsis; cursor: pointer; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; }
.ec-code-select:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--ec-line); }
.ec-code-select:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .7; }
.ec-code-select option { background-color: var(--vd-theme-panel-bg-strong, var(--vd-theme-panel-bg)); color: var(--vd-text); }
.ec-code-common { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.ec-code-common-title { margin-right: 4px; color: var(--vd-mat-label-color, var(--vd-theme-muted)); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.ec-chip-btn, .ec-code-print { min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--vd-mat-btn-border, var(--vd-theme-border)); border-radius: var(--vd-mat-btn-radius, var(--ds-radius-sm)); background: var(--vd-mat-btn, var(--vd-theme-control-bg)); box-shadow: var(--vd-mat-btn-shadow, none); color: var(--vd-mat-btn-text, inherit); font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }
.ec-chip-btn:hover, .ec-code-print:hover { background: var(--vd-mat-btn-hover, var(--vd-theme-control-hover)); }
.ec-code-print[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--vd-mat-selected-color, var(--vd-theme-accent-border)); background: var(--vd-mat-selected, var(--vd-theme-accent-soft)); box-shadow: var(--vd-mat-selected-edge, none); color: var(--vd-mat-selected-text, inherit); font-weight: 600; }

/* The result: the reading of the marking, the warnings of the engine and its errors */
.ec-code-result { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.ec-code-result h3 { margin: 0; }
.ec-code-error { margin: 0; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ec-bad); border-radius: var(--vd-mat-card-radius, var(--ds-radius-md)); background: linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--ec-bad) 14%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ec-bad) 14%, transparent)), var(--vd-mat-card, var(--vd-theme-panel-bg)); color: var(--ec-bad-text); }
.ec-code-rows { display: grid; gap: 2px; margin: 0; }
.ec-code-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, 220px) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ec-line) 60%, transparent); }
.ec-code-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.ec-code-row dt { color: var(--vd-mat-label-color, var(--vd-theme-muted)); font-weight: 600; }
.ec-code-row dd { min-width: 0; margin: 0; font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.ec-code-colour { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-right: 14px; font-family: var(--vd-font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); }
.ec-code-value { font-size: 16px; }
.ec-code-text { font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-size: 15px; }
.ec-code-empty { margin: 0; color: var(--vd-theme-muted); }
.ec-code-notes { max-width: 80ch; color: var(--vd-theme-muted); }
.ec-code-notes h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--vd-mat-heading-color, var(--vd-text)); font-family: var(--vd-mat-heading-font, inherit); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: var(--vd-mat-heading-weight, 600); letter-spacing: var(--vd-mat-heading-tracking, normal); text-transform: var(--vd-mat-heading-transform, none); }
.ec-code-notes ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.ec-code-notes li { margin: 0 0 4px; }
.ec-app[data-compact="true"] .ec-code-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; }
@media (pointer: coarse) { .ec-code-opt, .ec-chip-btn, .ec-code-print { min-height: 44px; } .ec-code-select { height: 44px; } }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    body:not([data-animations="false"]) .ec-band-ring { transition: stroke .12s ease; }
    body:not([data-animations="false"]) .ec-code-opt, body:not([data-animations="false"]) .ec-chip-btn, body:not([data-animations="false"]) .ec-code-print { transition: background-color .12s ease, border-color .12s ease, color .12s ease; }
}
/* end of code pages */
```

- **Markings:** SMD (`472` = 4,7 kΩ with the decimal comma, the chip prints `472`; `01C` is EIA-96 = 10 kΩ; value `10k` and tolerance `1 %` give `1002` with a button per marking `103`, `1002`, `01C`, the pressed one on the chip; `ABC` is an `invalid_code` with the chip dimmed; `4R7`), capacitor (`104K 1H` = 100 nF, K, 50 V on a two-line disc, the warning about voltage codes; 100 V gives `104K 2A`; `4.7n` gives `472K 2A`; tolerance J; four parts is an `invalid_code`; `4p7C` = 4,7 pF ±0,25 pF), ceramic (X7R: class 2 fields `X`, `7`, `R` with −55 °C, +125 °C, ±15 %; change P gives `X7P`; `Y5V` is asymmetric; class 1 shows its own fields and gives `U2G`; `np0` is C0G with the industry code NP0; the quick-pick button X7R; `QQQ` is an `invalid_code`; `U2J` sets class 1, −750 ppm and 120 ppm/K) the persistence of the last page and code, and two items the page cannot use (`ecalcCodesBrokenPatch`: a code kind without a controller and a resistor item with empty data) that must show `desktop.ecalc_page_unavailable` instead of breaking the app. After every page a change of the significant digits in the settings of the app (the shell then calls `page.refresh()`) must keep the page as it was.

```go
// ---- the pages in the desktop shell ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// ecalcCodeColors returns {code item id: {colour id: hex}} of the served catalog for the band kinds.
func ecalcCodeColors(t testing.TB, lang string) map[string]map[string]string {
	t.Helper()
	catalog, err := ecalc.Default()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	body, _, err := catalog.LocalizedJSON(lang)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var parsed struct {
		Items []struct {
			ID, Kind, Code string
			Data           struct {
				Colors []struct{ ID, Name, Hex string } `json:"colors"`
			} `json:"data"`
		} `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &parsed); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := map[string]map[string]string{}
	for _, item := range parsed.Items {
		if item.Kind != "code" || len(item.Data.Colors) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		out[item.ID] = map[string]string{}
		for _, color := range item.Data.Colors {
			out[item.ID][color.ID] = color.Hex
		}
	}
	if len(out) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("the catalog has %d code items with colours, want the resistor and the inductor", len(out))
	}
	return out
}

// ---- the pages in the desktop shell ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// codePageState is the code page of the window as the tests read it.
type codePageState struct {
	ID        string            `json:"id"`
	Kind      string            `json:"kind"`
	State     string            `json:"state"`
	Art       string            `json:"art"`
	Count     string            `json:"count"`
	Valid     string            `json:"valid"`
	Bands     []codeBandState   `json:"bands"`
	Chip      []string          `json:"chip"`
	Inputs    map[string]string `json:"inputs"`
	Rows      [][]string        `json:"rows"`
	Prints    []string          `json:"prints"`
	Warnings  []string          `json:"warnings"`
	Error     string            `json:"error"`
	ErrorCode string            `json:"errorCode"`
	Invalid   []string          `json:"invalid"`
	Panels    []string          `json:"panels"`
	Classes   string            `json:"classes"`
}

type codeBandState struct {
	Role     string `json:"role"`
	Color    string `json:"color"`
	Fill     string `json:"fill"`
	Caption  string `json:"caption"`
	Expanded string `json:"expanded"`
	Label    string `json:"label"`
}

const codePageStateJS = `()=>{
	const p=document.querySelector('.ec-code-page');
	if(!p)return 'null';
	const q=s=>p.querySelector(s),art=q('.ec-code-art');
	const radio=p.querySelector('input[name$="-class"]:checked');
	return JSON.stringify({
		id:p.dataset.code,kind:p.dataset.kind,state:p.dataset.state,art:art?art.dataset.art:'',count:art?art.dataset.bands||'':'',valid:art?art.dataset.valid||'':'',
		bands:[...p.querySelectorAll('.ec-band')].map(b=>({role:b.dataset.role,color:b.dataset.color,fill:b.querySelector('.ec-band-fill').getAttribute('fill'),caption:(b.querySelector('.ec-draw-cap')||{}).textContent||'',expanded:b.getAttribute('aria-expanded'),label:b.getAttribute('aria-label')})),
		chip:[...p.querySelectorAll('.ec-chip-text,.ec-disc-text')].map(x=>x.textContent),
		inputs:Object.fromEntries([...p.querySelectorAll('[data-input]')].map(i=>[i.dataset.input,i.value])),
		rows:[...p.querySelectorAll('.ec-code-row')].map(r=>[r.querySelector('dt').textContent,r.querySelector('dd').textContent]),
		prints:[...p.querySelectorAll('.ec-code-print')].map(b=>b.textContent+':'+b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')),
		warnings:[...p.querySelectorAll('.ec-warnings li')].map(l=>l.textContent),
		error:q('.ec-code-error').hidden?'':q('.ec-code-error').textContent,errorCode:q('.ec-code-error').dataset.code,
		invalid:[...p.querySelectorAll('.ec-code-field[data-state="error"]')].map(f=>f.dataset.field),
		panels:[...p.querySelectorAll('.ec-code-class')].filter(x=>!x.hidden).map(x=>x.dataset.class),classes:radio?radio.value:''
	});
}`

type codesHarness struct {
	*ecalcBrowserFixture
	t      *testing.T
	colors map[string]map[string]string // code item id -> colour id -> hex
	names  map[string]map[string]string // code item id -> colour id -> name in the language of the shell
}

func newCodesHarness(t *testing.T, patch string) *codesHarness {
	t.Helper()
	f := newECalcBrowserFixture(t, patch)
	h := &codesHarness{ecalcBrowserFixture: f, t: t, colors: ecalcCodeColors(t, "de"), names: map[string]map[string]string{}}
	body, _, err := f.Catalog.LocalizedJSON("de")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var parsed struct {
		Items []struct {
			ID   string
			Data struct {
				Colors []struct{ ID, Name string } `json:"colors"`
			} `json:"data"`
		} `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &parsed); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, item := range parsed.Items {
		h.names[item.ID] = map[string]string{}
		for _, color := range item.Data.Colors {
			h.names[item.ID][color.ID] = color.Name
		}
	}
	f.OpenApp(`.ec-page[data-calc]`)
	f.Wait(`()=>!!document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="codes"]')`)
	return h
}

func (h *codesHarness) read() codePageState {
	h.t.Helper()
	raw := h.Page.MustEval(codePageStateJS).Str()
	if raw == "null" {
		h.t.Fatal("no code page is open")
	}
	var state codePageState
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &state); err != nil {
		h.t.Fatalf("code page state %s: %v", raw, err)
	}
	return state
}

func (h *codesHarness) open(id string) {
	h.t.Helper()
	h.Page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="codes"]').click()`)
	h.Page.MustElement(`.ec-item[data-id="` + id + `"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-page')?.dataset.code==='` + id + `'`)
}

func (h *codesHarness) typeInto(selector, text string) {
	h.t.Helper()
	el := h.Page.MustElement(selector)
	el.MustClick()
	el.MustSelectAllText()
	el.MustInput(text)
}

func (h *codesHarness) choose(selector, value string) {
	h.t.Helper()
	h.Page.MustEval(`(s,v)=>{const e=document.querySelector(s);e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}`, selector, value)
}

func (h *codesHarness) radio(name, value string) {
	h.t.Helper()
	h.Page.MustEval(`(n,v)=>{const r=document.querySelector('.ec-code-page input[type="radio"][name$="-'+n+'"][value="'+v+'"]');r.checked=true;r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}`, name, value)
}

// colorsOf lists the colour ids of the drawn bands (the hex of every band is looked up in the data).
func (h *codesHarness) colorsOf(id string, state codePageState) []string {
	h.t.Helper()
	var out []string
	for _, band := range state.Bands {
		found := ""
		for color, name := range h.names[id] {
			if name == band.Color {
				found = color
			}
		}
		if found == "" {
			h.t.Fatalf("band colour %q is no colour of %s", band.Color, id)
		}
		if h.colors[id][found] != band.Fill {
			h.t.Fatalf("band %q is drawn with %q, the data says %q", band.Color, band.Fill, h.colors[id][found])
		}
		out = append(out, found)
	}
	return out
}

// waitColors waits until the drawn bands have the hex colours of the data for the given colour ids.
func (h *codesHarness) waitColors(id string, colors ...string) {
	h.t.Helper()
	var hex []string
	for _, color := range colors {
		hex = append(hex, h.colors[id][color])
	}
	want, _ := json.Marshal(hex)
	h.Wait(`()=>JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-band-fill')].map(b=>b.getAttribute('fill')))==='` + string(want) + `'`)
}

func (h *codesHarness) same(label string, got, want any) {
	h.t.Helper()
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		h.t.Fatalf("%s: got %v, want %v", label, got, want)
	}
}

func (h *codesHarness) row(state codePageState, name string) string {
	for _, row := range state.Rows {
		if row[0] == name {
			return row[1]
		}
	}
	return "<no row " + name + ">"
}

// setDigits changes the significant digits in the settings of the app (the shell then asks the open page to draw again).
func (h *codesHarness) setDigits(digits string) {
	h.t.Helper()
	h.Page.MustEval(`n=>{const s=document.querySelector('.ec-pop [data-set="sig"]');s.value=n;s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}`, digits)
}

func (h *codesHarness) noErrors() {
	h.t.Helper()
	if errors := h.Page.MustEval(`()=>JSON.stringify(fixtureErrors)`).Str(); errors != "[]" {
		h.t.Fatal(errors)
	}
}

// ecalcCodesBrokenPatch adds two code items the page cannot use to the served catalog: a code kind that has no controller and a
// resistor item whose data is empty. They must show the message of an unavailable page instead of breaking the app.
const ecalcCodesBrokenPatch = `j => {
	const item = (id, code) => ({ kind: 'code', id, category: 'codes', code, name: 'Fixture: ' + id, name_en: 'Fixture: ' + id, doc: '', tags: [], source: 'Fixture', data: {} });
	j.items.push(item('fx_broken', 'resistor_bands'), item('fx_unknown', 'mystery'));
	return j;
}`

// TestDesktopECalcCodesBandsBrowser drives the two colour-band pages: the colour menu of a band (mouse and keyboard),
// both directions (colours to value, value to colours), the number of bands, the warnings and the errors of the engine, the
// values that persist per item, and the reset.
func TestDesktopECalcCodesBandsBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	h := newCodesHarness(t, "j => j")
	page, words := h.Page, h.Words
	resistor, inductor := "resistor_color_code", "inductor_color_code"
	bandCenter := func(i int) string { return fmt.Sprintf(`.ec-band[data-index="%d"]`, i) }
	colorsNow := func(id string) []string { return h.colorsOf(id, h.read()) }

	// ---- the rail lists the five codes; the page opens with the 1 kOhm / 5 % example drawn from the data ----------------------------
	h.same("the Codes rail counts the five code items", page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="codes"] .ec-count').textContent`).Str(), "5")
	h.open(resistor)
	state := h.read()
	h.same("page", []string{state.ID, state.Kind, state.Art, state.Count}, []string{resistor, "resistor_bands", "resistor", "4"})
	h.same("the default is brown black red gold", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"brown", "black", "red", "gold"})
	h.same("roles of the four bands", []string{state.Bands[0].Role, state.Bands[1].Role, state.Bands[2].Role, state.Bands[3].Role}, []string{"digit", "digit", "multiplier", "tolerance"})
	h.same("captions under the bands", []string{state.Bands[0].Caption, state.Bands[1].Caption, state.Bands[2].Caption, state.Bands[3].Caption}, []string{"1", "0", "×10²", "±5 %"})
	h.same("value field", state.Inputs["value"], "1 kΩ")
	h.same("the reading names the value", h.row(state, words["desktop.ecalc_dim_resistance"]), "1 kΩ")
	h.same("the reading lists the colours by their German names", h.row(state, words["desktop.ecalc_code_colors"]), strings.Join([]string{h.names[resistor]["brown"], h.names[resistor]["black"], h.names[resistor]["red"], h.names[resistor]["gold"]}, " "))
	if len(state.Warnings) != 0 || state.Error != "" || state.State != "ok" {
		t.Fatalf("the default shows warnings or an error: %+v", state)
	}
	if aria := state.Bands[0].Label; !strings.Contains(aria, h.names[resistor]["brown"]) || !strings.Contains(aria, words["desktop.ecalc_code_role_digit"]) {
		t.Fatalf("the band has no useful accessible name: %q", aria)
	}
	h.Shot("code-resistor")

	// ---- the bands are tab stops: the Tab key after the band selector lands on the first band, which then shows its focus ring -------------------------------
	page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('input[name$="-bands"]:checked').focus()`)
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.Tab)
	h.Wait(`()=>document.activeElement.matches('.ec-band[data-index="0"]')`)
	if ring := page.MustEval(`()=>getComputedStyle(document.activeElement.querySelector('.ec-band-ring')).stroke`).Str(); ring == "none" || strings.Contains(ring, "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)") {
		t.Fatalf("the focused band has no focus ring: stroke %q", ring)
	}

	// ---- a click on a band opens the menu of the colours that fit its role, with the colour of the data -----------------------------------
	page.MustElement(bandCenter(0)).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>!document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)
	menu := page.MustEval(`()=>JSON.stringify({n:document.querySelectorAll('.ec-code-opt').length,label:document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').getAttribute('aria-label'),selected:document.querySelector('.ec-code-opt[aria-selected="true"]').dataset.color,
		expanded:document.querySelector('.ec-band[data-index="0"]').getAttribute('aria-expanded'),focus:document.activeElement.classList.contains('ec-code-opt'),
		swatches:[...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-code-opt')].map(o=>o.dataset.color+'='+o.querySelector('.ec-swatch rect').getAttribute('fill')),
		ring:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.ec-band[data-index="0"] .ec-band-ring')).stroke,
		inside:(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.ec-code-stage').getBoundingClientRect(),m=document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').getBoundingClientRect();return m.left>=s.left-1&&m.right<=s.right+1&&m.top>=s.top;})()})`).Str()
	var opened struct {
		N        int
		Label    string
		Selected string
		Expanded string
		Focus    bool
		Swatches []string
		Ring     string
		Inside   bool
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(menu), &opened); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if opened.N != 10 || opened.Selected != "brown" || opened.Expanded != "true" || !opened.Focus || !opened.Inside || opened.Label != strings.ReplaceAll(words["desktop.ecalc_code_menu"], "{n}", "1") {
		t.Fatalf("the digit menu: %+v", opened)
	}
	if opened.Ring == "none" || strings.Contains(opened.Ring, "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)") {
		t.Fatalf("the open band has no focus ring: stroke %q", opened.Ring)
	}
	for _, swatch := range opened.Swatches {
		pair := strings.SplitN(swatch, "=", 2)
		if h.colors[resistor][pair[0]] != pair[1] {
			t.Fatalf("menu swatch %s is not the hex of the data (%s)", swatch, h.colors[resistor][pair[0]])
		}
	}
	h.Shot("code-resistor-menu")
	page.MustElement(`.ec-code-opt[data-color="green"]`).MustClick()
	h.waitColors(resistor, "green", "black", "red", "gold")
	state = h.read()
	h.same("green is band 1", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"green", "black", "red", "gold"})
	h.same("the value follows the colours", state.Inputs["value"], "5 kΩ")
	h.same("the reading follows", h.row(state, words["desktop.ecalc_dim_resistance"]), "5 kΩ")
	h.same("focus returns to the band", page.MustEval(`()=>document.activeElement.matches('.ec-band[data-index="0"]')`).Bool(), true)

	// ---- the keyboard reaches the menu: Enter opens it, the arrows move, Enter picks, Escape closes ------------------------------------------
	page.MustElement(bandCenter(2)).MustFocus()
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.Enter)
	h.Wait(`()=>!document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden && document.activeElement.classList.contains('ec-code-opt')`)
	h.same("the menu opens on the colour of the band", page.MustEval(`()=>document.activeElement.dataset.color`).Str(), "red")
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.ArrowDown)
	h.same("ArrowDown moves to the next colour", page.MustEval(`()=>document.activeElement.dataset.color`).Str(), "orange")
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.Enter)
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden && document.activeElement.matches('.ec-band[data-index="2"]')`)
	h.same("the multiplier is orange", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"green", "black", "orange", "gold"})
	h.same("the value follows the multiplier", h.read().Inputs["value"], "50 kΩ")
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.Enter)
	h.Wait(`()=>!document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.Escape)
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden && document.activeElement.matches('.ec-band[data-index="2"]')`)
	h.same("Escape changed nothing", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"green", "black", "orange", "gold"})
	page.MustElement(bandCenter(2)).MustFocus()
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.ArrowLeft)
	h.same("ArrowLeft moves to the previous band", page.MustEval(`()=>document.activeElement.dataset.index`).Str(), "1")
	// A click outside closes the menu.
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.ArrowDown)
	h.Wait(`()=>!document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)
	page.MustElement(".ec-code-page .ec-title").MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)

	// ---- the tolerance menu lists the tolerance colours and no more ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	page.MustElement(bandCenter(3)).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>!document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)
	tolerances := page.MustEval(`()=>JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-code-opt')].map(o=>o.dataset.color))`).Str()
	h.same("the tolerance colours", tolerances, `["brown","red","orange","yellow","green","blue","violet","grey","gold","silver"]`)
	page.MustElement(`.ec-code-opt[data-color="silver"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)
	h.same("silver is the tolerance", h.read().Inputs["tolerance"], "10")

	// ---- value to colours: with the tolerance on automatic the engine assumes one and says so ----------------------------------------------------
	h.choose(`[data-input="tolerance"]`, "")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="value"]`, "4k7")
	h.waitColors(resistor, "yellow", "violet", "red", "gold")
	state = h.read()
	h.same("4k7 is yellow violet red gold", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"yellow", "violet", "red", "gold"})
	h.same("the warning of the engine is visible", state.Warnings, []string{"no tolerance given; ±5 % assumed"})
	h.same("the drawn captions", []string{state.Bands[0].Caption, state.Bands[1].Caption, state.Bands[2].Caption}, []string{"4", "7", "×10²"})
	h.choose(`[data-input="tolerance"]`, "1")
	h.waitColors(resistor, "yellow", "violet", "red", "brown")
	h.same("1 % is brown", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"yellow", "violet", "red", "brown"})

	// ---- the number of bands: 5 bands hold three digits, 6 bands add the temperature coefficient ---------------------------------------------------------
	h.radio("bands", "5")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-art').dataset.bands==='5'`)
	h.same("4.7k in five bands", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"yellow", "violet", "black", "brown", "brown"})
	h.same("the tempco field is off below six bands", page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="tempco"]').disabled`).Bool(), true)
	h.radio("bands", "6")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-art').dataset.bands==='6'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("six bands end with the temperature coefficient", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"yellow", "violet", "black", "brown", "brown", "brown"})
	h.same("the coefficient defaults to 100 ppm/K", state.Inputs["tempco"], "100")
	h.same("the roles of the six bands", state.Bands[5].Role, "tcr")
	h.choose(`[data-input="tempco"]`, "50")
	h.waitColors(resistor, "yellow", "violet", "black", "brown", "brown", "red")
	h.same("50 ppm/K is red", colorsNow(resistor)[5], "red")
	h.same("the reading lists the coefficient", h.row(h.read(), words["desktop.ecalc_code_field_tcr"]), "±50 ppm/K")
	h.Shot("code-resistor-six-bands")
	h.radio("bands", "3")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-art').dataset.bands==='3'`)
	h.same("three bands have no tolerance band", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"yellow", "violet", "red"})
	h.same("the tolerance is fixed at 20 %", page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="tolerance"]').disabled+'|'+document.querySelector('[data-input="tolerance"]').value`).Str(), "true|20")
	h.radio("bands", "4")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-art').dataset.bands==='4'`)

	// ---- errors of the engine stay inline: nothing reaches the console -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	h.choose(`[data-input="tolerance"]`, "1")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="value"]`, "4.75k")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').dataset.code==='unsupported'`)
	state = h.read()
	if !strings.Contains(state.Error, "3 significant digits") || !strings.HasPrefix(state.Error, words["desktop.ecalc_code_error_unsupported"]) || !reflect.DeepEqual(state.Invalid, []string{"value"}) || state.State != "error" {
		t.Fatalf("4.75k in four bands: %+v", state)
	}
	h.same("the drawing stays", len(state.Bands), 4)
	h.Shot("code-resistor-error")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="value"]`, "abc")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').dataset.code==='invalid_value'`)
	if state = h.read(); !strings.Contains(state.Error, `cannot read "abc"`) || !strings.HasPrefix(state.Error, words["desktop.ecalc_code_error_invalid_value"]) {
		t.Fatalf("abc: %+v", state)
	}
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="value"]`, "10k")
	h.waitColors(resistor, "brown", "black", "orange", "brown")
	h.same("10k is brown black orange brown", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"brown", "black", "orange", "brown"})

	// ---- the entered values persist per item ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	h.radio("bands", "5")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-art').dataset.bands==='5'`)
	want := colorsNow(resistor)
	h.CloseWindows()
	h.OpenApp(`.ec-page`)
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-page')?.dataset.code==='` + resistor + `'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("the bands persist", []string{state.Count, state.Inputs["value"], state.Inputs["tolerance"]}, []string{"5", "10 kΩ", "1"})
	h.same("the colours persist", colorsNow(resistor), want)
	h.setDigits("6")
	state = h.read()
	h.same("a change of the digits keeps the page as it was", []string{state.Count, state.Inputs["value"], state.State}, []string{"5", "10 kΩ", "ok"})
	h.same("and the colours", colorsNow(resistor), want)
	h.setDigits("4")
	h.same("a favorite is a click away", page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-page [data-action="favorite"]').getAttribute('aria-pressed')`).Str(), "false")
	page.MustElement(`.ec-code-page [data-action="favorite"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="favorites"] .ec-count').textContent==='1'`)
	// The reset button brings the example back.
	page.MustElement(`.ec-code-page [data-action="reset"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-art').dataset.bands==='4'`)
	h.same("reset", colorsNow(resistor), []string{"brown", "black", "red", "gold"})

	// ---- inductor: EIA (four bands) and the military code (a wide silver band first, gold is the decimal point) ----------------------------------------------------------------
	h.open(inductor)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("inductor page", []string{state.Art, state.Count, state.Inputs["value"]}, []string{"inductor", "4", "100 µH"})
	h.same("EIA colours", colorsNow(inductor), []string{"brown", "black", "brown", "silver"})
	h.same("EIA roles", []string{state.Bands[2].Role, state.Bands[3].Role}, []string{"multiplier", "tolerance"})
	h.radio("bands", "5")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-art').dataset.bands==='5'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("military code starts with silver", state.Bands[0].Role+"|"+state.Bands[0].Color, "identifier|"+h.names[inductor]["silver"])
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="value"]`, "6.8u")
	h.waitColors(inductor, "silver", "blue", "gold", "grey", "silver")
	h.same("6.8 µH is silver blue gold grey silver", colorsNow(inductor), []string{"silver", "blue", "gold", "grey", "silver"})
	h.same("the gold band is the decimal point", h.read().Bands[2].Caption, ".")
	page.MustElement(bandCenter(2)).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>!document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)
	h.same("gold is offered as the decimal point", page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-opt[data-color="gold"] .ec-opt-meaning').textContent`).Str(), words["desktop.ecalc_code_role_point"])
	page.MustElement(`.ec-code-opt[data-color="red"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)
	// silver blue red grey silver: 68 x 100 (the fourth band is a multiplier only up to orange): the engine says why.
	state = h.read()
	if state.ErrorCode != "invalid_code" || !strings.Contains(state.Error, "multiplier") {
		t.Fatalf("a digit that is no multiplier in band 4: %+v", state)
	}
	h.Shot("code-inductor-error")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="value"]`, "22u")
	h.waitColors(inductor, "silver", "red", "red", "black", "silver")
	h.same("22 µH military", colorsNow(inductor), []string{"silver", "red", "red", "black", "silver"})

	h.noErrors()
}

// TestDesktopECalcCodesMarkingsBrowser drives the three printed-code pages: SMD resistor (3-digit, 4-digit, EIA-96 and R
// notation, the chip drawing with the code printed on it), capacitor (value code, tolerance letter, voltage code) and ceramic
// temperature codes (class 1 and 2).
func TestDesktopECalcCodesMarkingsBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	h := newCodesHarness(t, ecalcCodesBrokenPatch)
	page, words := h.Page, h.Words
	field := func(id string) string { return words["desktop.ecalc_code_field_"+id] }

	// ---- SMD resistor ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	h.open("smd_resistor_code")
	state := h.read()
	h.same("smd page", []string{state.Kind, state.Art, state.Valid}, []string{"smd_resistor", "chip", "true"})
	h.same("the chip prints the code", state.Chip, []string{"472"})
	h.same("472 is 4,7 kOhm (decimal comma in German)", state.Inputs["value"], "4,7 kΩ")
	h.same("the notation", h.row(state, field("family")), "3-digit code")
	h.Shot("code-smd")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="code"]`, "01C")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-chip-text').textContent==='01C' && document.querySelector('[data-input="value"]').value==='10 kΩ'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("EIA-96", h.row(state, field("family")), "EIA-96")
	h.same("the code field keeps what was typed", state.Inputs["code"], "01C")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="value"]`, "10k")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="tolerance"]`, "1 %")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='1002'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("at 1 % the 4-digit code is primary", state.Chip, []string{"1002"})
	h.same("every marking is a button", state.Prints, []string{"103:false", "1002:true", "01C:false"})
	page.MustElement(`.ec-code-print[data-print="01C"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-chip-text').textContent==='01C'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("the pressed marking is on the chip", state.Prints, []string{"103:false", "1002:false", "01C:true"})
	h.same("and in the code field", state.Inputs["code"], "01C")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="code"]`, "ABC")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').dataset.code==='invalid_code'`)
	state = h.read()
	if state.Valid != "false" || !reflect.DeepEqual(state.Invalid, []string{"code"}) || !strings.Contains(state.Error, "SMD resistor code") {
		t.Fatalf("ABC: %+v", state)
	}
	h.same("the chip shows what was typed, dimmed", state.Chip, []string{"ABC"})
	h.Shot("code-smd-error")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="code"]`, "4R7")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').hidden`)
	h.same("R notation", h.read().Inputs["value"], "4,7 Ω")
	h.setDigits("6")
	h.same("a change of the digits keeps the SMD page", []string{h.read().Inputs["code"], h.read().Inputs["value"], h.read().State}, []string{"4R7", "4,7 Ω", "ok"})
	h.setDigits("4")

	// ---- capacitor ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	h.open("capacitor_code")
	state = h.read()
	h.same("capacitor page", []string{state.Kind, state.Art}, []string{"capacitor", "disc"})
	h.same("the disc prints the marking on two lines", state.Chip, []string{"104K", "1H"})
	h.same("104K 1H fields", []string{state.Inputs["value"], state.Inputs["tolerance"], state.Inputs["voltage"]}, []string{"100 nF", "K", "50"})
	h.same("tolerance and voltage in the reading", []string{h.row(state, field("tolerance")), h.row(state, field("voltage"))}, []string{"±10 %", "50 V"})
	if len(state.Warnings) == 0 || !strings.Contains(state.Warnings[0], "voltage codes are a maker convention") {
		t.Fatalf("the voltage code warning of the engine is missing: %v", state.Warnings)
	}
	h.choose(`[data-input="voltage"]`, "100")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='104K 2A'`)
	h.same("100 V is 2A", h.read().Chip, []string{"104K", "2A"})
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="value"]`, "4.7n")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='472K 2A'`)
	h.choose(`[data-input="tolerance"]`, "J")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='472J 2A'`)
	h.same("J is 5 %", h.row(h.read(), field("tolerance")), "±5 %")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="code"]`, "104 K 1H 3A")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').dataset.code==='invalid_code'`)
	if state = h.read(); !strings.Contains(state.Error, "at most three parts") || !reflect.DeepEqual(state.Invalid, []string{"code"}) {
		t.Fatalf("four parts: %+v", state)
	}
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="code"]`, "4p7C")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').hidden`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("4p7C is 4,7 pF, C is 0.25 pF", []string{state.Inputs["value"], state.Inputs["tolerance"], h.row(state, field("tolerance"))}, []string{"4,7 pF", "C", "±0,25 pF"})
	h.setDigits("6")
	h.same("a change of the digits keeps the capacitor page", []string{h.read().Inputs["value"], h.read().Inputs["tolerance"], h.read().State}, []string{"4,7 pF", "C", "ok"})
	h.setDigits("4")
	h.Shot("code-capacitor")

	// ---- ceramic temperature codes ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	h.open("ceramic_temp_code")
	state = h.read()
	h.same("ceramic default", []string{state.Kind, state.Classes, state.Inputs["code"], state.Inputs["low"], state.Inputs["high"], state.Inputs["change"]}, []string{"ceramic_temp", "2", "X7R", "X", "7", "R"})
	h.same("only the class 2 fields are shown", state.Panels, []string{"2"})
	h.same("X7R reading", []string{h.row(state, field("temp_low")), h.row(state, field("temp_high")), h.row(state, field("change"))}, []string{"−55 °C", "+125 °C", "±15 %"})
	h.choose(`[data-input="change"]`, "P")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='X7P'`)
	h.same("X7P", h.row(h.read(), field("change")), "±10 %")
	h.choose(`[data-input="low"]`, "Y")
	h.choose(`[data-input="high"]`, "5")
	h.choose(`[data-input="change"]`, "V")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='Y5V'`)
	h.same("Y5V is asymmetric", h.row(h.read(), field("change")), "+22 % / −82 %")
	h.radio("class", "1")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='U2G'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("class 1 shows its own fields", []string{state.Classes, strings.Join(state.Panels, ",")}, []string{"1", "1"})
	h.same("-750 ppm/K and 30 ppm/K make U2G", h.row(state, field("tc")), "−750 ppm/K")
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="code"]`, "np0")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='np0' && document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').hidden && document.querySelector('[data-input="tempco"]').value==='0 ppm'`)
	h.same("NP0 is C0G", h.row(h.read(), field("industry_code")), "NP0")
	page.MustElement(`.ec-chip-btn[data-pick="X7R"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('input[name$="-class"]:checked').value==='2' && document.querySelector('[data-input="code"]').value==='X7R'`)
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="code"]`, "QQQ")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').dataset.code==='invalid_code'`)
	if state = h.read(); !strings.Contains(state.Error, "unknown temperature coefficient letter Q") {
		t.Fatalf("QQQ: %+v", state)
	}
	h.typeInto(`[data-input="code"]`, "U2J")
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-code-error').hidden && document.querySelector('input[name$="-class"]:checked').value==='1'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("U2J fields", []string{state.Inputs["tempco"], state.Inputs["tol"], h.row(state, field("tolerance"))}, []string{"-750 ppm", "120", "±120 ppm/K"})
	h.setDigits("6")
	h.same("a change of the digits keeps the ceramic page", []string{h.read().Inputs["code"], h.read().Classes, h.read().State}, []string{"U2J", "1", "ok"})
	h.setDigits("4")
	h.Shot("code-ceramic")

	// ---- the printed codes persist per item as well: a new window opens on the last page with the last code ------------------------------------------------------
	h.CloseWindows()
	h.OpenApp(`.ec-page`)
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-page')?.dataset.code==='ceramic_temp_code'`)
	state = h.read()
	h.same("the ceramic page keeps its code and class", []string{state.Inputs["code"], state.Classes, h.row(state, field("tc"))}, []string{"U2J", "1", "−750 ppm/K"})

	// ---- an item the page cannot use says so: a code kind without a controller, a resistor whose data is empty ----------------------------------------------------
	for _, id := range []string{"fx_unknown", "fx_broken"} {
		h.open(id)
		h.same("the message for "+id, page.MustEval(`id=>document.querySelector('.ec-page[data-code="'+id+'"] .ec-empty-page').textContent`, id).Str(), words["desktop.ecalc_page_unavailable"])
	}

	h.noErrors()
}

// contrastJS measures the drawing of the open code page against what is behind it: translucent layers are laid over the next
// one outward, an image (a gradient) falls back to the strong panel colour of the skin.
const contrastJS = `()=>{
	const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=1;const cx=cv.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
	const rgba=css=>{cx.clearRect(0,0,1,1);cx.fillStyle='#000';cx.fillStyle=css;cx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);const d=cx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data;return [d[0],d[1],d[2],d[3]/255];};
	const over=(top,under)=>{const a=top[3];return [0,1,2].map(i=>top[i]*a+under[i]*(1-a)).concat([1]);};
	const lum=c=>{const f=v=>{v/=255;return v<=0.03928?v/12.92:Math.pow((v+0.055)/1.055,2.4);};return 0.2126*f(c[0])+0.7152*f(c[1])+0.0722*f(c[2]);};
	const ratio=(a,b)=>{const x=lum(a),y=lum(b);return (Math.max(x,y)+0.05)/(Math.min(x,y)+0.05);};
	const stage=document.querySelector('.ec-code-stage');
	const strong=over(rgba(getComputedStyle(stage).getPropertyValue('--vd-theme-panel-bg-strong')||'#fff'),[255,255,255,1]);
	const behind=el=>{const layers=[];for(let n=el;n;n=n.parentElement){const cs=getComputedStyle(n);if(cs.backgroundImage&&cs.backgroundImage!=='none')return strong;const c=rgba(cs.backgroundColor);if(c[3]>0)layers.push(c);if(c[3]>=1)break;}
		let base=strong;if(layers.length&&layers[layers.length-1][3]>=1)base=layers.pop();for(let i=layers.length-1;i>=0;i--)base=over(layers[i],base);return base;};
	const bg=behind(stage),out={bg:bg.map(Math.round).join(',')};
	const first=document.querySelector('.ec-band-fill');
	if(first){const cs=getComputedStyle(first),s=rgba(cs.stroke);s[3]*=parseFloat(cs.strokeOpacity);out.bandOutline=ratio(over(s,bg),bg);out.fills=[...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-band-fill')].map(b=>getComputedStyle(b).fill).join('|');
		const body=document.querySelector('.ec-draw-body');out.bodyOutline=ratio(rgba(getComputedStyle(body).stroke),bg);}
	const chip=document.querySelector('.ec-chip-body');
	if(chip){const body=rgba(getComputedStyle(chip).fill),ink=over(rgba(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.ec-chip-text')).fill),body);out.print=ratio(ink,body);out.chip=ratio(body,bg);}
	return JSON.stringify(out);
}`

// TestDesktopECalcCodesSkinsBrowser checks the drawings in every desktop skin: the colour of a band is the same everywhere
// (it comes from the data), the outline of the bands and of the body is legible against the stage, the printed code of the
// SMD chip against the chip; and a phone-sized window keeps the page and the colour menu inside the screen.
func TestDesktopECalcCodesSkinsBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	h := newCodesHarness(t, "j => j")
	page := h.Page
	skins := []string{}
	for _, theme := range parseDesktopThemeRegistry(t) {
		if theme.ID == "fruity" {
			skins = append(skins, "fruity-light", "fruity-dark")
		} else {
			skins = append(skins, theme.ID)
		}
	}
	type measure struct {
		Bg          string
		BandOutline float64
		BodyOutline float64
		Fills       string
		Print       float64
		Chip        float64
	}
	measureNow := func() measure {
		var m measure
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(page.MustEval(contrastJS).Str()), &m); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return m
	}
	const outlineMin, printMin = 3.0, 4.5
	h.open("resistor_color_code")
	var fills string
	for _, skin := range skins {
		page.MustEval(`id=>fixtureTheme(id)`, skin)
		m := measureNow()
		t.Logf("skin %-14s resistor: bands %.2f body %.2f (stage rgb %s)", skin, m.BandOutline, m.BodyOutline, m.Bg)
		if m.BandOutline < outlineMin || m.BodyOutline < outlineMin {
			t.Errorf("skin %s: the resistor outline is faint against the stage (bands %.2f, body %.2f, stage rgb %s, want %.1f)", skin, m.BandOutline, m.BodyOutline, m.Bg, outlineMin)
		}
		if fills == "" {
			fills = m.Fills
		} else if m.Fills != fills {
			t.Errorf("skin %s draws the bands in other colours than the standard skin: %s vs %s", skin, m.Fills, fills)
		}
		if skin == "fruity-dark" || skin == "cyberpunk" || skin == "minimal" {
			h.Shot("code-resistor-" + skin)
		}
	}
	h.open("smd_resistor_code")
	for _, skin := range skins {
		page.MustEval(`id=>fixtureTheme(id)`, skin)
		m := measureNow()
		t.Logf("skin %-14s smd chip: print %.2f chip %.2f (stage rgb %s)", skin, m.Print, m.Chip, m.Bg)
		if m.Print < printMin || m.Chip < outlineMin {
			t.Errorf("skin %s: the SMD chip is hard to read (print on chip %.2f, chip on stage %.2f, stage rgb %s, want %.1f and %.1f)", skin, m.Print, m.Chip, m.Bg, printMin, outlineMin)
		}
		if skin == "fruity-dark" || skin == "cyberpunk" || skin == "minimal" {
			h.Shot("code-smd-" + skin)
		}
	}
	page.MustEval(`()=>fixtureTheme('standard')`)

	// ---- a phone-sized window: the page does not move sideways and the menu stays on the stage -----------------------------------------------------------------
	h.CloseWindows()
	page.MustSetViewport(390, 667, 1, false)
	page.MustEval(`()=>fixtureTheme('fruity-dark')`)
	h.OpenApp(`.ec-app[data-compact="true"]`)
	h.Wait(`()=>!!document.querySelector('.ec-page')`)
	page.MustElement(".ec-back").MustClick()
	page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="codes"]').click()`)
	page.MustElement(`.ec-item[data-id="resistor_color_code"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-page')?.dataset.code==='resistor_color_code'`)
	page.MustElement(`.ec-band[data-index="3"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>!document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').hidden`)
	if got := page.MustEval(`()=>{const h=document.querySelector('.ec-page-host'),s=document.querySelector('.ec-code-stage').getBoundingClientRect(),m=document.querySelector('.ec-code-menu').getBoundingClientRect(),a=document.querySelector('.ec-code-art').getBoundingClientRect();
		return (h.scrollWidth>h.clientWidth+1?'the page scrolls sideways; ':'')+(m.left<s.left-1||m.right>s.right+1?'the menu leaves the stage; ':'')+(a.width<250?'the drawing is only '+a.width+' px wide; ':'');}`).Str(); got != "" {
		t.Fatal(got)
	}
	h.Shot("code-compact-menu")
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.Escape)
	page.MustElement(".ec-back").MustClick()
	page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="codes"]').click()`)
	page.MustElement(`.ec-item[data-id="capacitor_code"]`).MustClick()
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-page')?.dataset.code==='capacitor_code'`)
	if got := page.MustEval(`()=>{const h=document.querySelector('.ec-page-host');return h.scrollWidth>h.clientWidth+1?'the page scrolls sideways':'';}`).Str(); got != "" {
		t.Fatal(got)
	}
	h.Shot("code-compact-capacitor")
	h.noErrors()
}
```

### Task UK5: The code page and the loader

**Files:**
- Create: `ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-code-page.js`
- Modify: `ui/js/desktop/core/module-loader.js` (the `ecalc` entry: three scripts)
- Modify: `ui/desktop_ecalc_test.go` (`TestECalcUsesOnlyItsOwnTranslationKeys`: the code keys are allowed)
- Modify: `ui/desktop_ecalc_codes_browser_test.go` (`TestECalcCodePagesAreWired`, `TestECalcCodePageUsesTheEngineAndTheStore`, `TestECalcCodeKeysAreUsedByThePage`, `TestECalcCodeColoursAreHexInTheData`)

Structure of `ecalc-code-page.js` (about 1000 lines, below the 1100 line budget of `TestVirtualDesktopFirstPartyJSFilesStayBelowLineBudget`):

- `bandsController(ctx, cfg)` serves the resistor and the inductor from a `cfg` ({kind, dim, layouts with their roles, tolerances, temperature coefficients, the example}); a **role** is `{role, key, wide, pick(color), meaning(color, colors, index), short(...)}`: `pick` decides which colours the menu lists, `meaning` is the text next to a swatch (`4`, `×10²`, `±5 %`, `100 ppm/K`), `short` the caption under the band. `resistorRoles` and `inductorRoles` build the roles from the data (the military layout knows the identifier band, the decimal point and the fourth band that is a digit or a multiplier).
- Two directions run at the same time: the colours decode (`fromColors`: value, tolerance and coefficient fields follow) and the fields encode (`fromFields`: the colours follow); changing the number of bands moves the colours over role by role and re-encodes the value.
- `smdController`, `capacitorController`, `ceramicController` have the same interface: `markup()`, `mount(host)`, `state()`, `restore(saved)`, `reset()`, `refresh()`, `layout()`, `dispose()`, plus `valueHTML(field)` (the SMD marking buttons) and `handleClick(event)` (print button, quick pick).
- The page (`create`) owns the result block: `ctx.run(fn, source)` calls the engine and keeps `{result, error, source}`, `paintOutcome()` draws the error line (a translated lead plus the engine's English message, `role="alert"`), tints the field that is `source`, lists the reading (colours or marking, the value, the fields with names translated by id) and the warnings. Markup that did not change is not written again (`setMarkup`): a click that starts on a band, a menu option or a print button must not find it replaced when the blur of a field has just drawn the same result.
- An item the page cannot use (a code kind without a controller, data that lacks what its controller reads: the controller is built and mounted inside `try`) shows `desktop.ecalc_page_unavailable`, the message the shell uses for a kind without a page.
- `describe(error)` maps anything the engine throws to one of its three codes, so nothing reaches the console.
